    (function() {
      'use strict';

      // ====================================================================
      // 1. REUSABLE, SAFE FRONTEND API CLIENT (TradePulseApiClient)
      //    - Configurable base URL (no hardcoded secrets or prod domains)
      //    - Request timeout via AbortController
      //    - Safe JSON parsing & structured HTTP error handling
      //    - Sequence counters to prevent stale responses overwriting newer data
      // ====================================================================
      function detectDefaultBaseUrl() {
        try {
          const saved = localStorage.getItem('tp_api_base_url');
          if (saved && saved.trim()) return saved.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
        } catch (e) {}
        if (window.location && (window.location.protocol === 'http:' || window.location.protocol === 'https:')) {
          if (window.location.port === '8080' || window.location.pathname.indexOf('/public/') !== -1 || window.location.pathname === '/') {
            return window.location.origin.replace(/\/+$/, '');
          }
        }
        return 'http://127.0.0.1:8080';
      }

      function normalizeBaseUrl(raw) {
        const cleaned = String(raw || '').trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
        if (!cleaned) return 'http://127.0.0.1:8080';
        if (!/^https?:\/\/[a-zA-Z0-9._:-]+$/i.test(cleaned)) {
          throw new Error('API Base URL must be an http:// or https:// origin (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080).');
        }
        return cleaned;
      }

      const apiClient = {
        baseUrl: detectDefaultBaseUrl(),
        setBaseUrl: function(newUrl) {
          const norm = normalizeBaseUrl(newUrl);
          this.baseUrl = norm;
          try {
            localStorage.setItem('tp_api_base_url', norm);
          } catch (e) {}
          return norm;
        },
        request: async function(method, path, queryParams, timeoutMs) {
          const timeout = timeoutMs || 8000;
          let url = this.baseUrl + path;
          if (queryParams && typeof queryParams === 'object') {
            const usp = new URLSearchParams();
            Object.keys(queryParams).forEach(function(k) {
              const v = queryParams[k];
              if (v !== undefined && v !== null && String(v).trim() !== '') {
                usp.append(k, String(v).trim());
              }
            });
            const qs = usp.toString();
            if (qs) url += '?' + qs;
          }

          const controller = typeof AbortController !== 'undefined' ? new AbortController() : null;
          const timerId = controller ? setTimeout(function() { controller.abort(); }, timeout) : null;

          try {
            const resp = await fetch(url, {
              method: method,
              headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' },
              signal: controller ? controller.signal : undefined
            });
            const rawText = await resp.text();
            if (!rawText || !rawText.trim()) {
              throw new Error('Empty response from server (HTTP ' + resp.status + ').');
            }
            let data;
            try {
              data = JSON.parse(rawText);
            } catch (parseErr) {
              throw new Error('Malformed JSON response from ' + path + ' (HTTP ' + resp.status + ').');
            }
            if (!resp.ok) {
              const err = new Error((data && data.message) ? data.message : ('HTTP ' + resp.status + ' error on ' + path));
              err.status = resp.status;
              err.payload = data;
              throw err;
            }
            return data;
          } catch (err) {
            if (err && err.name === 'AbortError') {
              const timeoutErr = new Error('Request timed out after ' + (timeout / 1000).toFixed(1) + 's (' + path + ').');
              timeoutErr.isTimeout = true;
              throw timeoutErr;
            }
            throw err;
          } finally {
            if (timerId) clearTimeout(timerId);
          }
        },
        getHealth: function() { return this.request('GET', '/api/health', null, 6000); },
        getConfig: function() { return this.request('GET', '/api/config', null, 6000); },
        getSignals: function(params) { return this.request('GET', '/api/signals', params, 8000); },
        getOpportunityRankings: function(params) { return this.request('GET', '/api/opportunity-rankings', params, 8000); },
        getScans: function(params) { return this.request('GET', '/api/scans', params, 8000); },
        getOiSnapshots: function(params) { return this.request('GET', '/api/oi-snapshots', params, 8000); },
        getOiBaselines: function(params) { return this.request('GET', '/api/oi-baselines', params, 8000); },
        getPaperReport: function(params) { return this.request('GET', '/api/paper-portfolio', params, 8000); },
        getPaperSession: function(params) { return this.request('GET', '/api/paper-session', params, 8000); },
        getBacktestRuns: function() { return this.request('GET', '/api/backtest-runs', {limit: 5}, 8000); },
        getNotificationOutbox: function() { return this.request('GET', '/api/notification-outbox', {limit: 5}, 8000); },
        triggerScan: function() { return this.request('POST', '/api/scan', null, 20000); }
      };

      // Expose apiClient on window for deterministic testing & inspection
      window.TradePulseApiClient = apiClient;

      // ====================================================================
      // 2. APPLICATION STATE & REQUEST SEQUENCE GUARDS
      // ====================================================================
      const state = {
        health: null,
        config: null,
        signals: [],
        signalsTotal: 0,
        signalsOffset: 0,
        signalsLimit: 20,
        selectedSignalKey: null,
        scans: [],
        scansTotal: 0,
        scansOffset: 0,
        scansLimit: 15,
        oiSnapshots: [],
        selectedFoIndex: 'NIFTY',
        selectedSnapshotIdx: 0,
        scanInFlight: false,
        lastRefreshIst: null,
        refreshTimerId: null,
        rankingExpiryTimer: null,
        reqSeq: {
          health: 0,
          config: 0,
          signals: 0,
          scans: 0,
          oi: 0,
          headerIndexes: 0,
          rankings: 0
        }
      };

      let priceChartInstance = null;
      let oiChartInstance = null;
      let btChartInstance = null;

      // ====================================================================
      // 3. SAFE DOM & FORMATTING HELPERS (XSS Prevention via textContent)
      // ====================================================================
      function el(tag, className, text) {
        const node = document.createElement(tag);
        if (className) node.className = className;
        if (text !== undefined && text !== null) {
          node.textContent = String(text);
        }
        return node;
      }

      function clearChildren(node) {
        while (node && node.firstChild) {
          node.removeChild(node.firstChild);
        }
      }

      function formatInr(val) {
        if (val === null || val === undefined || typeof val === 'boolean' || (typeof val === 'string' && !val.trim())) return '--';
        const num = Number(val);
        if (!Number.isFinite(num)) return '--';
        return '₹' + num.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
      }

      function formatLakhs(val) {
        const num = Number(val);
        if (!Number.isFinite(num)) return '--';
        const lakhs = num / 100000.0;
        return (lakhs > 0 ? '+' : '') + lakhs.toFixed(2) + 'L';
      }

      function showToast(msg, isError) {
        const toast = document.getElementById('toastNotification');
        const text = document.getElementById('toastMessageText');
        const dot = document.getElementById('toastDot');
        if (!toast || !text || !dot) return;
        text.textContent = String(msg);
        dot.className = isError ? 'w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-rose-400 shrink-0' : 'w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 shrink-0';
        toast.className = isError
          ? 'fixed bottom-5 right-5 z-50 max-w-md rounded-xl bg-slate-900 border border-rose-500/60 px-4 py-3 shadow-2xl text-xs text-rose-100 flex items-center gap-2.5'
          : 'fixed bottom-5 right-5 z-50 max-w-md rounded-xl bg-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/50 px-4 py-3 shadow-2xl text-xs text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2.5';
        if (window._tpToastTimer) clearTimeout(window._tpToastTimer);
        window._tpToastTimer = setTimeout(function() {
          toast.classList.add('hidden');
        }, 3800);
      }

      function copyTextSafe(str, label) {
        try {
          const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
          ta.value = str;
          ta.style.position = 'fixed';
          ta.style.opacity = '0';
          document.body.appendChild(ta);
          ta.select();
          document.execCommand('copy');
          document.body.removeChild(ta);
          showToast('Copied ' + label + ' to clipboard!', false);
        } catch (e) {
          showToast('Copied ' + label, false);
        }
      }

      // ====================================================================
      // 4. HEALTH, SYSTEM STATUS & HEADER RIBBON (GET /api/health & /api/config)
      // ====================================================================
      function describeConnectionState(connState) {
        switch (connState) {
          case 'CONNECTED_VERIFIED':
            return {
              label: 'CONNECTED (provider response)',
              dotCls: 'w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 pulse-dot shrink-0',
              badgeCls: 'text-[10px] font-bold mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40'
            };
          case 'SIMULATED':
            return {
              label: 'SIMULATED',
              dotCls: 'w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400 shrink-0',
              badgeCls: 'text-[10px] font-bold mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40'
            };
          case 'CONFIGURED_UNVERIFIED':
            return {
              label: 'CONFIGURED_UNVERIFIED',
              dotCls: 'w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 shrink-0',
              badgeCls: 'text-[10px] font-bold mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/40'
            };
          case 'UNAVAILABLE_MISSING_CREDENTIALS':
            return {
              label: 'UNAVAILABLE_MISSING_CREDENTIALS',
              dotCls: 'w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-rose-400 shrink-0',
              badgeCls: 'text-[10px] font-bold mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/40'
            };
          case 'ERROR':
          case 'INVALID_CONFIG':
            return {
              label: connState,
              dotCls: 'w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500 shrink-0',
              badgeCls: 'text-[10px] font-bold mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-rose-500/25 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/40'
            };
          default:
            return {
              label: connState || 'UNKNOWN',
              dotCls: 'w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-slate-400 shrink-0',
              badgeCls: 'text-[10px] font-bold mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-800 text-slate-300'
            };
        }
      }

      async function loadHealthAndConfig() {
        const seq = ++state.reqSeq.health;
        state.reqSeq.rankings++;
        clearRankingExpiry();
        document.getElementById('opportunityRankingsContainer').textContent = 'Reading current evidence availability...';
        try {
          const [healthData, configData] = await Promise.all([
            apiClient.getHealth(),
            apiClient.getConfig()
          ]);
          if (seq !== state.reqSeq.health) return;

          state.health = healthData;
          state.reqSeq.reports = (state.reqSeq.reports || 0) + 1;
          document.getElementById('storedReportsContainer').textContent = 'Read stored reports for this health snapshot.';
          state.config = configData;
          state.lastRefreshIst = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-IN', { hour12: false });

          document.getElementById('globalApiErrorBanner').classList.add('hidden');
          renderHeaderHealth(healthData);
          renderSystemHealthTab(healthData, configData);
          renderOptionApexCapabilityBanner();
        } catch (err) {
          if (seq !== state.reqSeq.health) return;
          state.health = null;
          document.getElementById('opportunityRankingsContainer').textContent = 'Candidate priority unavailable: current health request failed.';
          state.reqSeq.reports = (state.reqSeq.reports || 0) + 1;
          document.getElementById('storedReportsContainer').textContent = 'Reports unavailable: current health request failed.';
          renderHeaderOffline(err);
          renderSystemHealthOffline(err);
        }
      }

      function clearRankingExpiry() {
        if (state.rankingExpiryTimer !== null && typeof clearTimeout === 'function') clearTimeout(state.rankingExpiryTimer);
        state.rankingExpiryTimer = null;
      }

      function renderOpportunityRankings(data, expired) {
        const container = document.getElementById('opportunityRankingsContainer');
        clearChildren(container);
        if (!data || data.actionable !== false || !data.snapshot) {
          container.appendChild(el('p', 'text-amber-300', 'Candidate priority unavailable: no qualified retained ranking for this source and universe.'));
          return;
        }
        const snapshot = data.snapshot;
        const fresh = !expired && data.status === 'CURRENT_CANDIDATE_PRIORITY';
        const rows = fresh ? data.current_rows : data.historical_rows;
        container.appendChild(el('p', fresh ? 'text-cyan-300' : 'text-amber-300', fresh ?
          'Current candidate priority — not an entry instruction or win probability.' :
          'Historical priority only — no current ranks available.'));
        const text = v => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() ? v : 'unavailable';
        const number = v => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v) ? String(v) : 'unavailable';
        container.appendChild(el('p', 'text-xs text-slate-400', 'Observed ' + text(snapshot.reference) +
          ' | Valid until ' + text(snapshot.valid_until) + ' | Source ' + text((snapshot.scope || {}).provider)));
        if (!Array.isArray(rows) || !rows.length) container.appendChild(el('p', '', fresh ?
          'No qualified cash candidate in the latest scan.' : 'No historical candidate rows in this view.'));
        (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows.slice(0, 100) : []).forEach(function(row) {
          const scores = row.score_components || {};
          const card = el('div', 'border border-slate-700 rounded p-3 space-y-1');
          card.appendChild(el('p', 'font-semibold', (fresh ? 'Rank ' : 'Historical rank ') + number(row.rank) +
            ' | ' + text(row.symbol) + ' | ' + text(row.direction) + ' | ' + text(row.strategy_id)));
          card.appendChild(el('p', '', 'Quality ' + number(scores.rule_quality) + ' | Gross T1 reward/risk ' +
            number(scores.actual_target1_rr) + ' | Previous rank ' + number(row.previous_rank)));
          const reasons = {NEWLY_QUALIFIED: 'Newly qualified', SCORE_COMPONENT_CHANGED: 'Score inputs changed',
            RELATIVE_ORDER_CHANGED: 'Other candidates changed order', UNCHANGED_PRIORITY: 'Priority unchanged'};
          card.appendChild(el('p', '', reasons[row.rank_change_reason] || text(row.rank_change_reason)));
          Object.entries(row.component_changes || {}).slice(0, 10).forEach(function(pair) {
            const change = pair[1] || {};
            card.appendChild(el('p', 'text-xs', pair[0] + ': ' + number(change.previous) + ' → ' + number(change.current)));
          });
          card.appendChild(el('p', 'text-xs text-slate-400', 'Source candle ' + text(row.source_data_watermark)));
          card.appendChild(el('p', 'text-xs text-amber-200', 'Unavailable inputs: ' +
            (Array.isArray(row.missing_components) ? row.missing_components.slice(0, 20).map(text).join(', ') : 'unavailable')));
          container.appendChild(card);
        });
        (snapshot.removals || []).slice(0, 100).forEach(function(row) {
          container.appendChild(el('p', 'text-xs text-amber-200', text(row.symbol) + ' removed from priority: ' + text(row.reason_code)));
        });
        const page = data.pagination || {};
        container.appendChild(el('p', 'text-xs text-slate-400', 'Showing ' + number(Array.isArray(rows) ? rows.length : 0) +
          ' of ' + number(page.total) + '. Stored candidate evidence; live acceptance and empirical performance remain separate.'));
      }

      async function loadOpportunityRankings() {
        const seq = ++state.reqSeq.rankings;
        const health = state.health;
        clearRankingExpiry();
        const container = document.getElementById('opportunityRankingsContainer');
        container.textContent = health ? 'Reading stored candidate priority...' : 'Candidate priority unavailable: current health is unavailable.';
        if (!health) return;
        try {
          const elapsedClock = typeof performance !== 'undefined' && performance && typeof performance.now === 'function' ?
            () => performance.now() : () => Date.now();
          const requestedAt = elapsedClock();
          const data = await apiClient.getOpportunityRankings({limit: 20});
          if (seq !== state.reqSeq.rankings || health !== state.health) return;
          // Use server timestamps and conservatively include the whole request
          // duration; client wall-clock skew cannot keep a rank alive longer.
          const lifetime = Date.parse((data.snapshot || {}).valid_until) - Date.parse(data.as_of) - Math.max(0, elapsedClock() - requestedAt);
          const expired = data.status === 'CURRENT_CANDIDATE_PRIORITY' && (!Number.isFinite(lifetime) || lifetime < 0);
          renderOpportunityRankings(data, expired);
          if (!expired && data.status === 'CURRENT_CANDIDATE_PRIORITY' && typeof setTimeout === 'function') {
            state.rankingExpiryTimer = setTimeout(function() {
              if (seq === state.reqSeq.rankings && health === state.health) renderOpportunityRankings(data, true);
            }, Math.max(1, lifetime + 1));
          }
        } catch (err) {
          if (seq !== state.reqSeq.rankings || health !== state.health) return;
          container.textContent = 'Candidate priority unavailable: retained evidence could not be verified. No cached ranks retained.';
        }
      }

      async function loadStoredReports() {
        const seq = state.reqSeq.reports = (state.reqSeq.reports || 0) + 1;
        const container = document.getElementById('storedReportsContainer');
        container.textContent = 'Reading retained reports...';
        const health = state.health;
        if (!health) {
          container.textContent = 'Reports unavailable: read current health first.';
          return;
        }
        const account = health.paper_account_id;
        const session = document.getElementById('paperReportSession').value;
        const requests = [
          ['Notification previews', () => apiClient.getNotificationOutbox()],
          ['Stored research runs', () => apiClient.getBacktestRuns()]
        ];
        if (account) requests.push(['Paper ledger', () => apiClient.getPaperReport({account_id: account})]);
        if (account && session) requests.push(['EOD statement', () => apiClient.getPaperSession({account_id: account, session_date: session})]);
        const results = await Promise.all(requests.map(async pair => {
          try { return {label: pair[0], data: await pair[1]()}; }
          catch (err) { return {label: pair[0], unavailable: true}; }
        }));
        if (seq !== state.reqSeq.reports || state.health !== health) return;
        renderStoredReports(results, account);
      }

      function renderStoredReports(results, account) {
        const container = document.getElementById('storedReportsContainer');
        clearChildren(container);
        container.appendChild(el('div', 'text-amber-300', 'LOCAL STORED EVIDENCE. Paper fills and research execution are simulations; live acceptance is separate.'));
        if (!account) container.appendChild(el('div', '', 'No paper account explicitly attached to this server.'));
        results.forEach(function(result) {
          const data = result.data || {};
          let text = result.label + ': ';
          if (result.unavailable) text += 'UNAVAILABLE (no cached values retained)';
          else if (result.label === 'Paper ledger') {
            const recon = (data.reconciliation || {}).status;
            if (recon !== 'OK') text += 'RECONCILIATION REQUIRED; accounting unavailable';
            else {
              const a = data.accounting || {};
              text += 'Reconciliation OK | Open ' + (a.open_positions ?? '--') + ' | Closed ' + (a.closed_positions ?? '--') +
                (paperMarksUnavailable(data) ? ' | Current equity and unrealized P&L unavailable' :
                  ' | Equity ' + formatInr(a.equity_inr)) + ' | Fees ' + formatInr(a.fees_paid_inr) +
                ' | Stored snapshot as of ' + (data.as_of_ist || 'unavailable') +
                ' | Entry blocks: ' + (data.entry_blocks || []).join(', ');
            }
          } else if (result.label === 'EOD statement') {
            text += data.status + ' | ' + (data.eod_status || 'No accepted EOD statement') +
              ' | ' + (data.session_date || '--') + ' | Statement ' + (data.statement_sha256 || 'unavailable');
          } else if (result.label === 'Notification previews') {
            text += 'LOCAL PREVIEW ONLY; real delivery disabled | ' + JSON.stringify(data.counts || {});
            text += ' | ' + (data.items || []).map(function(item) {
              return (item.kind || 'CANDIDATE_PREVIEW') + ' ' + (item.delivery_state || item.status || 'UNAVAILABLE') +
                ' | Candidate ' + (item.candidate_id || 'unavailable') + ' | Snapshot ' + (item.context_snapshot_id || 'not applicable');
            }).join('; ');
            text += ' | ' + (data.context_alert_decisions || []).map(function(decision) {
              return 'Context alert ' + decision.status + ': ' + decision.reason_code;
            }).join('; ');
          } else {
            text += 'Retained ' + (data.total_count ?? '--') + ' | ' + (data.items || []).map(function(run) {
              return [run.run_id, run.data_mode || 'UNQUALIFIED', run.strategy_id, run.symbol].join(' / ');
            }).join('; ');
          }
          container.appendChild(el('div', 'mono border-b border-slate-800 py-1', text));
          if (result.label === 'Paper ledger' && !result.unavailable) renderPaperJournal(data, container);
        });
      }

      function paperMarksUnavailable(data) {
        return (data.entry_blocks || []).some(function(code) {
          return code === 'MISSING_OR_STALE_MARKS' || code === 'UNRESOLVED_EOD_POSITION';
        });
      }

      function persistedQuantity(value) {
        return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0 ? String(value) : 'unavailable';
      }

      // Only an existing read-only account snapshot is rendered here. Rendering never
      // dispatches observations, scans, fills or broker actions.
      function renderPaperJournal(data, container) {
        const journal = el('section', 'border border-slate-700 rounded p-3 space-y-2');
        journal.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Stored simulated paper journal');
        journal.appendChild(el('h4', 'font-bold text-slate-200', 'Paper journal — simulated execution'));
        container.appendChild(journal);
        if ((data.reconciliation || {}).status !== 'OK') {
          journal.appendChild(el('p', 'text-amber-300', 'Journal withheld: reconciliation required.'));
          return;
        }
        const value = function(v) {
          return typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() ? v :
            typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v) ? String(v) : 'unavailable';
        };
        journal.appendChild(el('p', 'text-amber-200',
          'Source ' + value(data.source_data_mode) + ' | Provider ' + value(data.provider) +
          ' | Fill policy ' + value(data.fill_policy) + ' | As of ' + value(data.as_of_ist) +
          '. Retained observations do not establish a current market quote.'));
        const sections = [
          ['Setups and decisions', 'candidate_decisions', data.total_candidate_decisions, function(d) {
            const candidate = d.candidate || {};
            const rule = d.trigger_contract || {};
            const history = Array.isArray(d.history) ? d.history : [];
            return value(d.status) + ' | ' + value(d.reason_code) + ' | ' + value(candidate.symbol) +
              ' | ' + value(candidate.strategy_id) + ' | Setup ' + value(d.candidate_id) +
              ' | Signal time ' + value(candidate.timestamp) + ' | Position ' + value(d.position_id) +
              ' | Trigger rule ' + value(rule.rule_id) + ' | Strategy version ' + value(rule.strategy_version) +
              ' | Observed trigger time ' + value(d.trigger_timestamp_ist) +
              ' | Last decision time ' + value(history.length ? history[history.length - 1].observed_at_ist : null);
          }],
          ['Positions', 'positions', data.total_positions, function(p) {
            const closed = p.status === 'CLOSED';
            const pnl = closed ? 'Closed net P&L ' + formatInr(p.net_pnl_inr) :
              paperMarksUnavailable(data) ? 'Current unrealized P&L unavailable' :
                'Retained unrealized net P&L ' + formatInr(p.unrealized_net_pnl_inr);
            return value(p.status) + ' | ' + value(p.symbol) + ' | ' + value(p.side) +
              ' | Position ' + value(p.position_id) + ' | Qty ' + persistedQuantity(p.quantity) +
              ' | Raw entry ' + formatInr(p.raw_entry_price) + ' | Effective entry ' + formatInr(p.effective_entry_price) +
              ' | Fill time ' + value(p.fill_timestamp_ist) + ' | Stop ' + formatInr(p.stop_loss) +
              ' | Target ' + formatInr(p.target_price) + ' | Mark time ' + value(p.mark_timestamp_ist) +
              ' | ' + pnl + ' | Exit ' + value(p.exit_reason) + ' at ' + value(p.exit_timestamp_ist) +
              ' | Charges ' + formatInr((p.costs || {}).charges_inr) +
              ' | Modeled slippage ' + formatInr((p.costs || {}).slippage_inr);
          }],
          ['Retained events', 'events', data.total_events, function(e) {
            return value(e.kind) + ' | Event ' + value(e.event_id) + ' | Position ' + value(e.position_id) +
              ' | Result ' + value((e.result || {}).status) + ' | ' + value((e.result || {}).reason_code);
          }]
        ];
        sections.forEach(function(section) {
          const rows = Array.isArray(data[section[1]]) ? data[section[1]] : [];
          journal.appendChild(el('h5', 'font-semibold text-slate-200', section[0] + ' — showing ' +
            Math.min(rows.length, 40) + ' of retained total ' + value(section[2])));
          rows.slice(0, 40).forEach(function(row) {
            journal.appendChild(el('p', 'mono border-b border-slate-800 py-1 break-words', section[3](row || {})));
          });
          if (!rows.length) journal.appendChild(el('p', 'text-slate-400', 'No rows in this retained preview.'));
          if (rows.length > 40 || (data.previews_truncated || {})[section[1]]) {
            journal.appendChild(el('p', 'text-amber-200', 'Partial preview; complete retained pages are available through /api/paper-ledger.'));
          }
        });
      }

      function renderHeaderHealth(health) {
        const broker = (health && health.broker) || {};
        const db = (health && health.database) || {};
        const sched = (health && health.scheduler) || {};
        const lastScan = (health && health.last_scan) || null;

        const connInfo = describeConnectionState(broker.connection_state);
        document.getElementById('apiHealthDot').className = connInfo.dotCls;
        document.getElementById('activeBrokerBadge').textContent = broker.broker_name || broker.active_broker || 'Unknown Broker';
        const stateBadge = document.getElementById('brokerStateBadge');
        stateBadge.textContent = connInfo.label;
        stateBadge.className = connInfo.badgeCls;

        const modeBadge = document.getElementById('headerDataModeBadge');
        if (health && health.evidence_scope === 'OFFLINE_FIXTURE_NOT_LIVE_ACCEPTANCE') {
          modeBadge.textContent = 'OFFLINE FIXTURE';
        } else if (broker.is_simulated || broker.data_mode === 'SIMULATED') {
          modeBadge.textContent = 'SIMULATED DATA MODE';
          modeBadge.className = 'text-[11px] font-bold uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 mono';
        } else if (health && health.live_acceptance && health.live_acceptance.accepted === true) {
          modeBadge.textContent = 'LIVE ACCEPTANCE EVIDENCE VALID';
          modeBadge.className = 'text-[11px] font-bold uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40 mono';
        } else {
          modeBadge.textContent = 'LIVE ACCEPTANCE UNVERIFIED';
          modeBadge.className = 'text-[11px] font-bold uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/40 mono';
        }

        const schedLabel = sched.running
          ? 'RUNNING'
          : (sched.enabled_in_config ? 'STOPPED (Enabled)' : 'DISABLED (Opt-In)');
        const lastScanLabel = lastScan
          ? (lastScan.scan_status + ' @ ' + (lastScan.completed_at_ist || '--'))

      function renderSystemHealthTab(health, configPayload) {
        const container = document.getElementById('healthDetailsContainer');
        const cfgContainer = document.getElementById('configDetailsContainer');
        clearChildren(container);
        clearChildren(cfgContainer);

        const overallBadge = document.getElementById('healthOverallBadge');
        overallBadge.textContent = (health && health.status === 'ok') ? 'HEALTHY (HTTP 200)' : 'DEGRADED';
        overallBadge.className = (health && health.status === 'ok')
          ? 'px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs font-bold mono bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40'
          : 'px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs font-bold mono bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/40';

        const broker = (health && health.broker) || {};
        const db = (health && health.database) || {};
        const sched = (health && health.scheduler) || {};

        const scripInfo = broker.scrip_master || {};
        const oaInfo = broker.option_apex || {};
        const oaIndices = oaInfo.indices || {};
        const niftyOa = (oaIndices.NIFTY && oaIndices.NIFTY.status) || oaInfo.overall_status || '--';
        const bnfOa = (oaIndices.BANKNIFTY && oaIndices.BANKNIFTY.status) || oaInfo.overall_status || '--';
        const scripSummary = (scripInfo.status || '--') + (
          scripInfo.index_options_loaded !== undefined
            ? (' (' + scripInfo.index_options_loaded + ' opt contracts' + (scripInfo.file_age_hours !== null && scripInfo.file_age_hours !== undefined ? ', age ' + scripInfo.file_age_hours + 'h' : '') + ')')
            : ''
        );

        const cFresh = broker.candle_freshness || {};
        const candleFreshLabel = (cFresh.status || 'NOT_CHECKED') + (
          cFresh.latest_candle_timestamp_ist ? (' (Bar: ' + cFresh.latest_candle_timestamp_ist + ' IST)') : ''
        );
        const rows = [
          ['Operational alerts', ((health.operations || {}).alerts || []).join(', ') || 'None recorded (local scope)'],
          ['Notification previews', JSON.stringify((health.operations || {}).notification_counts || {}) + ' (no real delivery)'],
          ['Broker Adapter', (broker.broker_name || '--') + ' [' + (broker.active_broker || '--') + ']'],
          ['Broker Connection State', (broker.connection_state || '--') + (broker.error_category && broker.error_category !== 'NONE' && broker.error_category !== 'SIMULATED' ? (' [' + broker.error_category + ']') : '')],
          ['Continuous feed', broker.stream ? ((broker.stream.status || 'UNAVAILABLE') + (broker.stream.live_signal_allowed ? ' | completed data available' : ' | signals blocked')) : 'Not configured'],
          ['Live Connectivity Verified', broker.connectivity_verified ? 'YES (Verified @ ' + (broker.last_verified_at_ist || '--') + ' IST)' : 'NO (Not Live-Verified)'],
          ['Last Market-Data Time (IST)', (broker.last_market_data_at_ist || 'None') + (broker.last_quote_timestamp_ist ? (' | Quote Feed: ' + broker.last_quote_timestamp_ist + ' IST') : '')],
          ['Candle Freshness Status', candleFreshLabel],
          ['Data Mode', broker.data_mode || '--'],
          ['Option Apex (Strategy 3) Readiness', (oaInfo.overall_status || '--') + ' [NIFTY: ' + niftyOa + ' | BANKNIFTY: ' + bnfOa + ']'],

      // ====================================================================
      // 5. SIGNALS TERMINAL (Connected to GET /api/signals)
      // ====================================================================
      function getSignalFilterParams() {
        const seg = document.getElementById('filterSegment').value;
        const strat = document.getElementById('filterStrategy').value;
        const dir = document.getElementById('filterDirection').value;
        const mode = document.getElementById('filterDataMode').value;
        const symRaw = (document.getElementById('searchSymbol').value || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        const limitVal = parseInt(document.getElementById('selectPageLimit').value, 10) || 20;
        state.signalsLimit = Math.min(200, Math.max(1, limitVal));

        const params = {
          limit: state.signalsLimit,
          offset: state.signalsOffset
        };
        if (seg && seg !== 'ALL') params.segment = seg;
        if (strat && strat !== 'ALL') params.strategy_id = strat;
        if (dir && dir !== 'ALL') params.direction = dir;
        if (mode && mode !== 'ALL') params.data_mode = mode;
        if (symRaw) {
          if (!/^[A-Z0-9&-]{1,20}$/.test(symRaw)) {
            throw new Error('Symbol filter may only contain letters, digits, & or - (e.g. NIFTY, M&M, SBIN).');
          }
          params.symbol = symRaw;
        }
        return params;
      }

      async function loadSignals() {
        const container = document.getElementById('signalCardsContainer');
        const badge = document.getElementById('signalCountBadge');
        let params;
        try {
          params = getSignalFilterParams();
        } catch (valErr) {
          showToast(valErr.message, true);
          return;
        }

        const seq = ++state.reqSeq.signals;
        badge.textContent = 'Loading...';
        clearChildren(container);
        container.appendChild(
          el('div', 'glass-card rounded-xl p-6 text-center text-xs text-slate-400 mono', 'Loading persisted signals from GET /api/signals...')
        );

        try {
          const res = await apiClient.getSignals(params);
          if (seq !== state.reqSeq.signals) return;
          if (!res || !Array.isArray(res.items)) {
            throw new Error('Malformed /api/signals payload: missing items array.');
          }
          state.signals = res.items;
          state.signalsTotal = Number.isFinite(Number(res.total_count)) ? Number(res.total_count) : res.items.length;
          renderSignalCards();
        } catch (err) {
          if (seq !== state.reqSeq.signals) return;
          state.signals = [];
          state.signalsTotal = 0;
          badge.textContent = 'Error';
          clearChildren(container);
          const errBox = el('div', 'glass-card rounded-xl p-5 border border-rose-500/40 bg-rose-950/20 space-y-2 text-xs');
          errBox.appendChild(el('div', 'font-bold text-rose-300', 'Failed to load signals from GET /api/signals'));
          errBox.appendChild(el('p', 'text-rose-200 mono', err && err.message ? err.message : 'Unknown API error'));
          const retryBtn = el('button', 'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-400 text-slate-950 font-bold transition', 'Retry Loading Signals');
          retryBtn.type = 'button';
          retryBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { loadSignals(); });
          errBox.appendChild(retryBtn);
          container.appendChild(errBox);
          renderEmptySignalInspector('API Error');
        }
      }

      function describeStoredSignalSource(signal) {
        let label = 'UNKNOWN SOURCE';
        let palette = 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border-slate-600';
        if (signal.evidence_scope === 'OFFLINE_FIXTURE_NOT_LIVE_ACCEPTANCE') {
          label = 'OFFLINE FIXTURE';
        } else if (signal.data_mode === 'SIMULATED' && signal.is_simulated === true) {
          label = 'SIMULATED';
          palette = 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/40';
        } else if (signal.data_mode === 'LIVE' && signal.is_simulated === false &&
                   ['angelone', 'upstox', 'dhan'].includes(signal.provider)) {
          // Persisted source provenance never establishes present-day freshness.
          label = 'LIVE SOURCE (STORED)';
          palette = 'bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border-cyan-500/40';
        }
        return { label: label, className: 'px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold border mono ' + palette };
      }

      function signalRiskRewardText(signal) {
        const risk = (signal.candidate_evaluation || {}).risk_reward || {};
        if (risk.allowed === true && Number.isFinite(risk.target1_ratio) && Number.isFinite(risk.target2_ratio)) {
          return 'Gross R:R T1 ' + risk.target1_ratio.toFixed(2) + ' / T2 ' + risk.target2_ratio.toFixed(2) +
            ' | Net R:R unavailable';
        }
        return 'Nominal R:R ' + (signal.risk_reward || '--') + ' | Numeric R:R unavailable';
      }

      function scanEvaluationText(scan) {
        const rows = (scan.evaluation || {}).strategy_evaluations || [];
        const candidates = (scan.evaluation || {}).candidate_evaluations || [];
        if (!rows.length && !candidates.length) return 'Evaluation details unavailable';
        const reasons = rows.map(function(row) {
          const warmup = row.warmup || {};
          const count = warmup.observed !== null && warmup.observed !== undefined ?
            ' (' + warmup.observed + '/' + warmup.required + ' bars)' : '';
          return row.symbol + ' ' + row.strategy_id + ': ' + row.status + count + ' ' +
            (row.reason_codes || []).join(', ');
        });
        candidates.forEach(function(candidate) {
          reasons.push(candidate.symbol + ' ' + candidate.strategy_id + ': Candidate ' + candidate.status +
            ' ' + (candidate.reason_codes || []).join(', '));
        });
        const context = scan.context;
        if (context && Array.isArray(context.candidate_contexts)) {
          reasons.push('Context ' + (context.evaluation_mode || 'DECISION_TIME') + ' @ ' + (context.as_of || 'unavailable') + ': ' +
            context.candidate_contexts.map(function(row) { return row.status + ' ' + (row.reason_codes || []).join(', '); }).join('; '));
        } else reasons.push('Context unavailable; no neutral assessment');
        return reasons.join(' | ');
      }

      function safeContextSourceUrl(value) {
        if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length > 2048 || !/^https:\/\//i.test(value) ||
            /[\\\s\u0000-\u001f\u007f-\uffff]/.test(value)) return null;
        try {
          const parsed = new URL(value);
          const host = parsed.hostname.toLowerCase();
          if (parsed.protocol !== 'https:' || parsed.username || parsed.password ||
              (parsed.port && parsed.port !== '443') || !host.includes('.') || host.endsWith('.') ||
              host === 'localhost' || host.endsWith('.localhost') || host.endsWith('.local') ||
              !/^[a-z0-9.-]+$/.test(host) || /^[0-9.]+$/.test(host) ||
              host.split('.').some(function(label) { return !label || label.startsWith('-') || label.endsWith('-'); })) return null;
          return parsed.href;
        } catch (_) { return null; }
      }

      function renderCandidateContext(container, context, metadata, candidate, decision) {
        clearChildren(container);
        const meta = metadata || context || {};
        const states = ['QUALIFIED', 'WARNING_ONLY', 'UNAVAILABLE', 'MISSING'];
        if (!context || !states.includes(context.status) || context.actionable !== false || context.affects_ranking !== false) {
          container.appendChild(el('div', 'text-amber-200', 'Context UNAVAILABLE; no neutral assessment or change to candidate eligibility.'));
          return;
        }
        if (candidate && context.candidate_id !== candidate.candidate_id) {
          container.appendChild(el('div', 'text-rose-300', 'Context UNAVAILABLE: candidate identity conflict.'));
          return;
        }
        const records = Array.isArray(context.records) ? context.records : [];
        const expected = ((candidate || {}).source_reference || {}).instrument_identity;
        const identityFields = ['provider','symbol','identifier','exchange','segment','instrument_type','is_index','source','source_revision'];
        if (context.status === 'QUALIFIED' && (!records.length || records.some(function(record) {
          const verification = record.verification || {};
          const actual = record.instrument_identity || {};
          return verification.allowed !== true || verification.status !== 'QUALIFIED_UNDER_LOCAL_POLICY' ||
            (record.freshness || {}).status !== 'FRESH' || record.retracted || record.conflict || !expected ||
            identityFields.some(function(key) { return actual[key] !== expected[key]; });
        }))) {
          container.appendChild(el('div', 'text-rose-300', 'Context UNAVAILABLE: inconsistent source qualification or instrument mapping.'));
          return;
        }
        container.appendChild(el('div', 'font-semibold', 'Context ' + context.status + ' | ' + (context.reason_codes || []).join(', ')));
        container.appendChild(el('div', 'mono text-[10px]', (meta.evaluation_mode || 'DECISION_TIME') + ' | As of ' +
          (meta.as_of || 'unavailable') + ' | Original decision ' + (meta.decision_at || 'unavailable')));
        container.appendChild(el('div', 'text-amber-200',
          meta.evaluation_mode === 'CURRENT_INFORMATION' ?
          'Current information for a stored candidate; no current recommendation. Original strategy and rank unchanged.' :
          'Informational context only. Missing context is not neutral; strategy, rank and actionability remain unchanged.'));
        if (decision) container.appendChild(el('div', 'mono', 'Context alert ' + decision.status + ': ' + decision.reason_code + ' | no real delivery'));
        if (!records.length) {
          container.appendChild(el('div', 'text-slate-400', 'No context record available for this identity and time.'));
          return;
        }
        records.slice(0, 8).forEach(function(record) {
          const actual = record.instrument_identity || {};
          if (!expected || identityFields.some(function(key) { return actual[key] !== expected[key]; })) {
            container.appendChild(el('div', 'text-rose-300', 'Context record withheld: canonical instrument mapping unavailable or conflicting.'));
            return;
          }
          const block = el('div', 'p-2 border border-slate-700 rounded space-y-1');
          const verification = record.verification || {};
          const verified = verification.allowed === true && verification.status === 'QUALIFIED_UNDER_LOCAL_POLICY';
          block.appendChild(el('div', 'font-semibold', record.title || 'Title unavailable'));
          block.appendChild(el('div', '', record.summary || 'Source summary unavailable'));
          block.appendChild(el('div', 'mono text-[10px]',
            (record.source_name || record.source_id || 'Source unavailable') + ' | ' +
            (verified ? 'QUALIFIED UNDER LOCAL POLICY; independent authority/rights not established' : 'UNVERIFIED / WARNING ONLY') +
            ' | Freshness ' + ((record.freshness || {}).status || 'UNAVAILABLE') +
            ' | Retracted ' + (record.retracted === true ? 'YES' : 'NO') +
            ' | Conflict ' + (record.conflict === true ? 'YES' : 'NO') +
            ' | Correction ' + (record.correction ? 'YES' : 'NO') +
            ' | ' + (record.reason_codes || []).join(', ')));
          block.appendChild(el('div', 'mono text-[10px]', 'Published: ' + (record.published_at || 'unavailable') +
            ' | Event: ' + (record.event_at || 'unavailable') + ' | Collected: ' + (record.collected_at || 'unavailable')));
          block.appendChild(el('div', 'mono text-[10px]', 'Record ' + (record.record_id || 'unavailable') +
            ' | Original ' + (record.original_ref || 'unavailable')));
          if (record.interpretation && record.interpretation.text) block.appendChild(el('div', 'text-amber-200',
            'Source-supplied interpretation (unvalidated): ' + record.interpretation.text + ' | Rule ' + (record.interpretation.rule_id || 'unavailable')));
          const url = safeContextSourceUrl(record.source_url);
          if (url) {
            const link = el('a', 'text-cyan-300 underline', 'Source record');
            link.href = url;
            link.target = '_blank';
            link.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
            block.appendChild(link);
          } else block.appendChild(el('div', 'text-amber-200', 'Source link unavailable or unsafe.'));
          container.appendChild(block);
        });
        if (records.length > 8) container.appendChild(el('div', '', 'Showing 8 of ' + records.length + ' retained records.'));
      }

      function renderSignalCards() {
        const container = document.getElementById('signalCardsContainer');
        // Restore only focus that belonged to a replaced card, never a filter
        // or other control the user reached while an asynchronous read completed.
        const focusedCardKey = document.activeElement && container.contains(document.activeElement)
          ? document.activeElement.getAttribute('data-signal-key') : null;
        let restoredCardFocus = false;
        const badge = document.getElementById('signalCountBadge');
        const pageInfo = document.getElementById('signalsPaginationInfo');
        const prevBtn = document.getElementById('btnPrevSignalsPage');
        const nextBtn = document.getElementById('btnNextSignalsPage');

        clearChildren(container);
        const items = state.signals || [];
        const total = state.signalsTotal || 0;
        badge.textContent = total + (total === 1 ? ' setup' : ' setups');

        const startIdx = total === 0 ? 0 : state.signalsOffset + 1;
        const endIdx = Math.min(total, state.signalsOffset + items.length);
        pageInfo.textContent = total > 0 ? ('Showing ' + startIdx + '–' + endIdx + ' of ' + total) : '0 results';
        prevBtn.disabled = state.signalsOffset <= 0;
        nextBtn.disabled = (state.signalsOffset + state.signalsLimit) >= total;

        if (items.length === 0) {
          const emptyBox = el('div', 'glass-card rounded-xl p-6 text-center space-y-2.5 text-xs');
          emptyBox.appendChild(el('div', 'text-slate-200 font-semibold text-sm', 'No Persisted Signals Found'));
          emptyBox.appendChild(
            el('p', 'text-slate-400', 'The database returned 0 signals for the current filter criteria. Click "⚡ Scan Market Now" to run a scan or reset filters.')
          );
          const scanBtn = el('button', 'px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-bold transition', '⚡ Scan Market Now');
          scanBtn.type = 'button';
          scanBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { triggerManualScan(); });
          emptyBox.appendChild(scanBtn);
          container.appendChild(emptyBox);
          renderEmptySignalInspector('No Signal Selected');
          if (focusedCardKey !== null) document.getElementById('btnRefreshDashboard').focus({preventScroll: true});
          return;
        }

        const hasSelected = items.some(function(s) {
          return (s.dedup_key || String(s.id)) === state.selectedSignalKey;
        });
        if (!hasSelected) {
          state.selectedSignalKey = items[0].dedup_key || String(items[0].id);
        }

        items.forEach(function(s) {
          const sigKey = s.dedup_key || String(s.id);
          const isSelected = sigKey === state.selectedSignalKey;
          const dirStr = String(s.direction || '').toUpperCase();
          const isBull = dirStr.indexOf('BULLISH') !== -1;
          const sourceInfo = describeStoredSignalSource(s);
          const qualityScore = storedQuality(s);

          const borderCls = isSelected
            ? 'border-emerald-500 ring-1 ring-emerald-500/40 bg-slate-900/95'
            : 'border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-700';

          const card = el('div', 'signal-card-item glass-card rounded-xl p-3.5 cursor-pointer transition border focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-cyan-400 ' + borderCls);
          card.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
          card.setAttribute('role', 'button');
          card.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Inspect signal ' + (s.instrument_label || s.symbol || ''));
          card.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(isSelected));
          card.setAttribute('data-signal-key', String(sigKey));

          // Top row: Instrument + Direction (with icon) + Segment + Data Mode + Quality Score
          const topRow = el('div', 'flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2');
          const leftBadges = el('div', 'flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5');
          leftBadges.appendChild(el('span', 'font-bold text-sm text-white mono', s.instrument_label || s.symbol || 'UNKNOWN'));

          const dirIcon = isBull ? '▲ ' : '▼ ';
          const dirCls = isBull
            ? 'px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30 mono'
            : 'px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/30 mono';
          leftBadges.appendChild(el('span', dirCls, dirIcon + (s.direction || 'UNKNOWN')));

          const segCls = s.segment === 'NSE_FO_INDEX'
            ? 'px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-semibold bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-300'
            : 'px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-semibold bg-sky-500/15 text-sky-300';
          leftBadges.appendChild(el('span', segCls, s.segment === 'NSE_FO_INDEX' ? 'NIFTY/BNF F&O' : 'NSE EQUITY'));

          leftBadges.appendChild(el('span', sourceInfo.className, sourceInfo.label));
          topRow.appendChild(leftBadges);

          const rightMeta = el('div', 'flex items-center gap-2 text-xs');
          rightMeta.appendChild(el('span', 'text-cyan-400 font-semibold mono', 'Quality ' + (qualityScore === null ? 'unavailable' : qualityScore + '/100')));
          rightMeta.appendChild(el('span', 'text-slate-400 mono', s.timestamp || '--'));
          topRow.appendChild(rightMeta);
          card.appendChild(topRow);

          // Second row: Strategy name + Position Type + Qty
          const midRow = el('div', 'mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs');
          midRow.appendChild(el('span', 'text-slate-300 font-medium', (s.strategy_name || s.strategy_id || '--') + ' • ' + (s.position_type || '--')));
          midRow.appendChild(el('span', 'mono text-slate-400', 'Persisted Qty: ' + persistedQuantity(s.position_qty) + ' | ' + signalRiskRewardText(s)));
          card.appendChild(midRow);
          const candidateEvaluation = s.candidate_evaluation || {};
          const retainedRank = candidateEvaluation.ranking || {};
          const maturity = s.strategy_evidence || candidateEvaluation.strategy_evidence || {};
          card.appendChild(el('div', 'mt-1 text-xs text-slate-300',
            'Scan rank: ' + (Number.isInteger(retainedRank.rank) && retainedRank.rank > 0 ? retainedRank.rank : 'unavailable') +
            ' | Historical scan ' + (s.scan_run_id || 'unavailable') + ' | ' +
            (maturity.maturity_state || 'Evidence maturity unavailable')));
          const decision = s.paper_decision || {};
          card.appendChild(el('div', 'mt-1 text-xs text-amber-200 mono',
            'Stored candidate | ' + (s.recommendation_status || 'CANDIDATE_ONLY') +
            ' | ' + (decision.reason_code || 'Paper eligibility not evaluated')));
          const context = s.context;
          card.appendChild(el('div', 'mt-1 text-xs text-slate-300 mono', context && context.actionable === false &&
            context.affects_ranking === false && ['QUALIFIED', 'WARNING_ONLY', 'UNAVAILABLE', 'MISSING'].includes(context.status) ?
            'Context ' + context.status + ' | ' + (context.reason_codes || []).join(', ') + ' | informational only' :
            'Context UNAVAILABLE; no neutral assessment'));
          if (s.lineage && s.lineage.batch_ids && s.lineage.batch_ids.length) {
            card.appendChild(el('div', 'mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400 mono',
              'Input batch: ' + s.lineage.batch_ids.join(', ') + ' | Scan: ' + s.scan_run_id));
          }

          // Bottom row: Entry, Stop, Invalidation, T1, T2
          const gridRow = el('div', 'mt-2.5 grid grid-cols-5 gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/80 text-xs mono');
          const cols = [
            ['ENTRY', formatInr(s.entry_price), 'text-white font-semibold'],
            ['INVALIDATION', formatInr(s.invalidation_level), 'text-amber-300 font-semibold'],
            ['STOP (S1)', formatInr(s.stop_loss), 'text-rose-400 font-semibold'],
            ['TARGET 1', formatInr(s.target_1), 'text-emerald-400 font-semibold'],
            ['TARGET 2', formatInr(s.target_2), 'text-cyan-400 font-semibold']
          ];
          cols.forEach(function(c) {
            const cell = el('div', '');
            cell.appendChild(el('span', 'text-slate-400 text-[10px] block', c[0]));
            cell.appendChild(el('span', c[2], c[1]));
            gridRow.appendChild(cell);
          });
          card.appendChild(gridRow);

          function selectCard() {
            state.selectedSignalKey = sigKey;
            renderSignalCards();
          }
          card.addEventListener('click', selectCard);
          card.addEventListener('keydown', function(ev) {
            if (ev.key === 'Enter' || ev.key === ' ') {
              ev.preventDefault();
              selectCard();
            }
          });
          container.appendChild(card);
          if (focusedCardKey !== null && focusedCardKey === String(sigKey)) {
            card.focus({preventScroll: true});
            restoredCardFocus = true;
          }
        });

        if (focusedCardKey !== null && !restoredCardFocus) {
          document.getElementById('btnRefreshDashboard').focus({preventScroll: true});
        }

        const selectedSig = items.find(function(s) {
          return (s.dedup_key || String(s.id)) === state.selectedSignalKey;
        }) || items[0];
        if (selectedSig) {
          renderSelectedSignalInspector(selectedSig);
        }
      }

      function renderEmptySignalInspector(titleText) {
        document.getElementById('detailSymbolTitle').textContent = titleText || 'No Signal Selected';
        document.getElementById('detailDirectionBadge').textContent = '--';
        document.getElementById('detailDataModeBadge').textContent = '--';
        document.getElementById('detailStrategySubtitle').textContent = 'Run a scan or select a signal card to view levels';
        document.getElementById('detailRrrBadge').textContent = 'R:R --';

      async function loadOiSnapshots() {
        renderOptionApexCapabilityBanner();
        const banner = document.getElementById('oiSnapshotStateBanner');
        const expiryVal = (document.getElementById('filterOiExpiry').value || '').trim();
        const modeVal = document.getElementById('filterOiDataMode').value;

        if (expiryVal && !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(expiryVal)) {
          showToast('Expiry filter must be in YYYY-MM-DD format.', true);
          return;
        }

        const params = {
          index_symbol: state.selectedFoIndex,
          limit: 20,
          offset: 0
        };
        if (expiryVal) params.expiry = expiryVal;
        if (modeVal && modeVal !== 'ALL') params.data_mode = modeVal;

        const seq = ++state.reqSeq.oi;
        banner.classList.remove('hidden');
        banner.textContent = 'Loading persisted OI snapshots for ' + state.selectedFoIndex + ' from GET /api/oi-snapshots...';

        try {
          const res = await apiClient.getOiSnapshots(params);
          if (seq !== state.reqSeq.oi) return;
          if (!res || !Array.isArray(res.items)) {
            throw new Error('Malformed /api/oi-snapshots response.');
          }
          state.oiSnapshots = res.items;
          state.selectedSnapshotIdx = 0;
          populateSnapshotSelector(res.items);

          if (res.items.length === 0) {
            banner.classList.remove('hidden');
            banner.textContent = 'No persisted OI snapshots found for ' + state.selectedFoIndex + '. Click "⚡ Scan Market Now" to capture and persist option-chain snapshots.';
            renderEmptyOptionApex();
            return;
          }
          banner.classList.add('hidden');
          renderOptionApexSnapshot(res.items[0]);
        } catch (err) {
          if (seq !== state.reqSeq.oi) return;
          state.oiSnapshots = [];
          banner.classList.remove('hidden');
          banner.textContent = 'Error loading OI snapshots: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'API error');
          renderEmptyOptionApex();
        }
      }

      function populateSnapshotSelector(items) {
        const sel = document.getElementById('selectOiSnapshotHistory');
        clearChildren(sel);
        if (!items || items.length === 0) {
          sel.appendChild(el('option', '', 'No snapshots available'));
          return;
        }
        items.forEach(function(snap, idx) {
          const opt = el(
            'option',
            '',
            '#' + snap.id + ' • ' + snap.snapshot_timestamp + ' IST [' + snap.data_mode + '] (PCR ' + Number(snap.pcr).toFixed(2) + ')'
          );
          opt.value = String(idx);
          sel.appendChild(opt);
        });
      }

      function renderOptionApexSnapshot(snap) {
        if (!snap) {
          renderEmptyOptionApex();
          return;
        }
        const isSim = Boolean(snap.is_simulated || snap.data_mode === 'SIMULATED');
        const modeBadge = document.getElementById('foDataModeBadge');
        modeBadge.textContent = isSim ? 'SIMULATED' : 'LIVE';
        modeBadge.className = isSim
          ? 'text-[10px] font-bold mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40'
          : 'text-[10px] font-bold mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40';

        const pcr = Number(snap.pcr || 0);
        document.getElementById('foPcrValue').textContent = pcr.toFixed(2);
        const pcrBiasEl = document.getElementById('foPcrBias');
        if (pcr >= 1.10) {
          pcrBiasEl.textContent = 'Bullish Put Floor (≥1.10)';
          pcrBiasEl.className = 'text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 font-semibold';
        } else if (pcr <= 0.85) {
          pcrBiasEl.textContent = 'Bearish Call Wall (≤0.85)';
          pcrBiasEl.className = 'text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-300 font-semibold';
        } else {
          pcrBiasEl.textContent = 'Neutral PCR (0.85–1.10)';
          pcrBiasEl.className = 'text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 font-semibold';
        }

        document.getElementById('foTotalOiSubtext').textContent =
          'CE OI: ' + Number(snap.total_ce_oi || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN') +
          ' | PE OI: ' + Number(snap.total_pe_oi || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN');

        // Rolling intraday comparison card
        const diff = snap.intraday_oi_diff || {};
        const compStatus = diff.comparison_status || 'NO_PRIOR_SNAPSHOT';
        const compEl = document.getElementById('foComparisonStatus');
        const compSub = document.getElementById('foComparisonSubtext');
        compEl.textContent = compStatus;
        if (compStatus === 'VALID_INTRADAY_DIFF') {
          compEl.className = 'text-sm font-bold mono text-emerald-400';
          compSub.textContent =
            'Δt ' + (diff.elapsed_minutes ?? '--') + 'm vs ' + (diff.previous_snapshot_timestamp || '--') +
            ' | ΔCE: ' + formatLakhs(diff.total_ce_oi_delta) +
            ' | ΔPE: ' + formatLakhs(diff.total_pe_oi_delta) +
            ' | ΔPCR: ' + (diff.pcr_delta !== null && diff.pcr_delta !== undefined ? Number(diff.pcr_delta).toFixed(3) : '--');
        } else if (compStatus === 'STALE_PRIOR_SNAPSHOT') {
          compEl.className = 'text-sm font-bold mono text-rose-400';
          compSub.textContent = 'Prior snapshot (' + (diff.previous_snapshot_timestamp || '--') + ') is stale (>60m or prior day); deltas suppressed.';
        } else {
          compEl.className = 'text-sm font-bold mono text-amber-300';
          compSub.textContent = 'First snapshot for (' + snap.index_symbol + ', ' + snap.expiry + ', ' + snap.data_mode + '). Run another scan within 60m to compute rolling delta.';
        }

        document.getElementById('foSpotAndAtm').textContent =
          'Spot: ' + formatInr(snap.spot) + ' | ATM: ' + (snap.atm_strike || '--');
        document.getElementById('foExpiryAndMeasure').textContent =
          'Expiry: ' + (snap.expiry || '--') + ' | Measure: ' + (snap.oi_change_measure || '--') + ' | Max Pain: Unavailable';
        document.getElementById('foChartMeasureTag').textContent = snap.oi_change_measure || '';
        document.getElementById('foSnapshotTimestampLabel').textContent =
          'Snapshot: ' + (snap.snapshot_timestamp || '--') + ' IST • ' + (snap.broker || '--');

        // Matching Option Apex signal from loaded signals
        const matchingSig = (state.signals || []).find(function(s) {
          return s.symbol === snap.index_symbol && s.strategy_id === 'strat_3_option_apex_oi';
        });
        if (matchingSig) {
          document.getElementById('foTopPickContract').textContent =
            matchingSig.instrument_label + ' [' + matchingSig.data_mode + ']';
          document.getElementById('foTopPickLevels').textContent =
            'Entry ' + formatInr(matchingSig.entry_price) +

            ' | T1 ' + formatInr(matchingSig.target_1);
        } else {
          document.getElementById('foTopPickContract').textContent = 'No Active Option Apex Signal';
          document.getElementById('foTopPickLevels').textContent = 'Current OI/PCR/VWAP conditions did not trigger Strategy 3';
        }

        // Render strike table safely using textContent
        const tbody = document.getElementById('optionChainTableBody');
        clearChildren(tbody);
        const strikes = Array.isArray(snap.strikes) ? snap.strikes : [];

          tr.appendChild(el('td', 'py-2 px-2 ' + (ceChg < 0 ? 'text-emerald-400 font-semibold' : 'text-rose-400'), formatLakhs(ceChg)));
          tr.appendChild(el('td', 'py-2 px-2 text-white font-semibold', formatInr(r.ce_ltp) + ' (' + Number(r.ce_iv || 0).toFixed(1) + '%)'));
          tr.appendChild(
            el(
              'td',
              'py-2 px-2 text-center font-bold ' + (isAtm ? 'text-emerald-300 bg-emerald-500/15' : 'text-amber-300 bg-slate-900'),
              String(r.strike) + (isAtm ? ' ★ ATM' : '')
            )
          );
          tr.appendChild(el('td', 'py-2 px-2 text-white font-semibold', formatInr(r.pe_ltp) + ' (' + Number(r.pe_iv || 0).toFixed(1) + '%)'));
          tr.appendChild(el('td', 'py-2 px-2 ' + (peChg > 0 ? 'text-emerald-400 font-semibold' : 'text-rose-400'), formatLakhs(peChg)));
          tr.appendChild(el('td', 'py-2 px-2 text-slate-300', Number(r.pe_oi || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')));

          let activityTag = 'Balanced OI';
          if (ceChg < 0 && peChg > 0) activityTag = '▲ Call Unwinding + Put Writing';
          else if (peChg < 0 && ceChg > 0) activityTag = '▼ Put Unwinding + Call Writing';
          else if (ceChg > 0 && peChg > 0) activityTag = 'Straddle / Both Writing';
          tr.appendChild(el('td', 'py-2 px-2 text-[11px] font-sans text-cyan-300', activityTag));
          tbody.appendChild(tr);
        });

        // Render Strike OI Change Chart
        const ctx = document.getElementById('optionOiChart').getContext('2d');
        if (oiChartInstance) oiChartInstance.destroy();
        oiChartInstance = new Chart(ctx, {
          type: 'bar',
          data: {
            labels: strikes.map(function(s) { return String(s.strike); }),
            datasets: [
              {
                label: 'Call OI Change (Lakhs)',
                data: strikes.map(function(s) { return +(Number(s.ce_oi_change || 0) / 100000).toFixed(2); }),
